free_tier_limits.correction: Personal plan: 100 requests/day; species data, hardiness maps, and care guides/FAQ for species 1-3000; plant-disease API entries 1-100.

rate_limits.correction: Published daily allowances are 100 requests for Personal, 10,000 for Premium, and 100,000 for Supreme; Enterprise has custom limits.

description.correction: REST API providing plant species catalogs and details, care guides, hardiness maps, pest/disease listings, and other botanical data. A free Personal plan is available; plant identification is a separate beta API, and the documented disease endpoint lists diseases rather than identifying them.

notes: The API is documented as active and online. The directory entry is outdated chiefly because its species-list example omits the current /v2 path and because Perenual now publishes plan-specific daily request allowances. No official CORS policy was located.
